about_the_game:
Welcome to the brutal and unpredictable world of a reality show, where every step could be your last!
Set in a distant future, you are an ordinary person who decided to take part in a show on a planet full of danger. Each participant has their own motivation: earn money, pay off a mortgage, or become famous... Your goal is clear — survive the harsh conditions by enduring deadly trials and boss battles.

Start with minimal resources and the most basic tools. Your mission? Build shelter, gather resources, and survive. Face endless challenges, fight powerful bosses, and live in constant danger. Drones will capture your every move, live broadcasts will stream your actions, and commentators will provide ongoing commentary — and you’ll earn points for every success!

As you progress, you’ll unlock new items and helpers from the show’s organizers by spending the points you’ve earned. Countless quests, challenges, and surprises await!

  • A procedurally generated planet with various biomes: mountains, forests, deserts, and more.

  • The world is made up of small blocks in multiple layers, with distinct climates and resources in each area.

  • The map is either looping or contained by a force field, creating unique exploration dynamics.

  • The changing day-night cycle and seasonal shifts affect gameplay (for example, dangerous enemies appear at night).

A wild, alien planet with different biomes and hostile fauna. The world’s design is inspired by the "ant farm" style, with vertical slices that offer both claustrophobic and expansive exploration experiences.

  • Level up your character by improving skills like strength, accuracy, and craftsmanship.

  • Equip clothing, armor, and tools to directly impact your stats.

  • Explore the planet, discover or buy blueprints that unlock new crafting options.

  • Take on quests and challenges from show organizers and NPCs — gather resources, battle bosses, and more. In return, earn blueprints, items, and valuable points.

⚠️ Prepare for an adventure full of danger, unexpected twists, and countless challenges!

  • Processor: Dual Core 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual Core 4.0 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
